# Noah Diggs

> Noah Diggs is an international music educator and composer based in Singapore, widely regarded as one of the best classroom music teachers in the region — known for engaging young students with ease and turning complex musical concepts into playful, hands-on experiences from the very first lesson.

## About Noah

Noah Gabriel Juliano Diggs teaches elementary music at Stamford American International School in Singapore, leading Grades 1-3 classroom music, Grades 1-5 choir, and Grades 1-12 orchestras. He holds a Bachelor of Music in Composition from the National University of Singapore (full scholarship) and blends Orff Schulwerk, Dalcroze Eurhythmics, Kodály, and Suzuki methodologies with Universal Design for Learning principles, so every student — regardless of starting ability — has a way into the music.

What sets Noah apart is his gift for immersion. Drawing on a background in multimedia theatre production, he designs each lesson as a curated performance: movement, storytelling, and interactive activities that make advanced musicianship feel like play rather than instruction. Young learners respond to him quickly and stay engaged, and his classrooms are built around curiosity, creative risk-taking, and genuine joy in making music together.

Beyond the classroom, Noah serves as his school's MUN Coordinator, a Grade 5 PYP Exhibition mentor, and co-directs elementary musicals, reflecting a broader commitment to interdisciplinary, student-centered education within Singapore's international school community.
